verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing documents a built-in automation capability: Rovo AI can create custom automations and rules that move work forward, and automation can connect tools to any Jira workflow. That makes the capability direct, but the evidence stays at headline level. Nothing explicitly confirms a no-code builder or chaining multiple steps (trigger, conditions, several actions) in one rule. missing for 10: explicit no-code/visual rule-builder documentation, evidence of multi-step rules with conditions and branching, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build multi-step automations without writing code

citations.quote: Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date - from automated reminders to rules that move work forward.
Connect your tools to any Jira workflow with automation. Whether your team is using Bitbucket, Slack, or any other tool, automation keeps Jira up to date, so you don't have to.
Scale processes and save time with customizable workflows that integrate with your tech stack.
